kfcb7104ea0.text: Welcome. I am Kaito. Sit down, get comfortable, and serve when you are ready.

k79f9367b27.text: So, a new face. Good. I like to know who I am playing. Show me.

kd029345fd6.text: Kaito. Forty years I coach this game. Today I coach you, whether you like it or not.

k934c448683.text: Sit. Try not to embarrass yourself.

k7a73d72a89.text: You are my opponent today? Hm. Interesting choice.

kc439c6609a.text: I have beaten better players before breakfast. Serve.

k664d32da6f.text: First time at my table. Do not worry. Everybody loses the first time. And the second.

k8ba1673388.text: New player. Let me guess. You watched some videos, now you think you are dangerous.

k680e1f3f62.text: Welcome to my table. Fair warning: I do not go easy, and I do not shut up.

k480ecb6a34.text: Sit down. Let us find out how bad this is going to be. For you, I mean.

k8b67401c80.text: You came back. Good. That is the first sign of a real player.

k4b5ee82291.text: Ah, you again. Ready? Take a breath first.

kc80010f843.text: Back for more. I respect that. A little.

kfa0be1481a.text: You again. Did you practise, or did you only think about practising?

k5b283eead4.text: Welcome back. Your seat is still warm from last time you lost in it.

k9abc456c72.text: Oh, look who it is. You missed me, yes? Everybody misses me.

kb950fbeefc.text: Back again. Some people never learn. I am glad. It is good for my record.

k9f8ae76298.text: You came back for more punishment. I admire it. Stupid, but I admire it.

k4f3d6a8ed4.text: Last time you beat me. Well played. Today I am ready for you.

kf54fda19c8.text: You won last time. I have been thinking about it. Every day.

k3052b6a6bb.text: Last time, you got lucky. Today we find out which one of us is the player.

k9e3397995d.text: I remember last time. Do not think I forgot. I never forget.

k8f07c04a3c.text: You beat me once. Once. Do not get comfortable.

k1d41e3d26b.text: Last time you won. I did not sleep well. Today you will pay for my sleep.

kf5dcfefa4f.text: You beat me last time and I have been pissed off ever since. Serve.

k55ce478180.text: Last time was hard for you. Today, a little better. That is all I ask.

k1b3e0628e4.text: Good, you came back after last time. Many people do not.

k99aff72f72.text: Last time I won. Today maybe you make it interesting.

kc5f0942fc7.text: Back after last time? Brave. Or you forgot the score.

kc86861db6f.text: I beat you last time. I will beat you this time. But please, try.

ka8144965f9.text: Last time was a lesson. Today, the same lesson, louder.

k51db391b13.text: After last time, I thought you quit. Hell, I would have quit.

k5ce1112501.text: Again. Good. That is how you get better.

k5d8a1f6399.text: Another one. Same focus as the last points, please.

k2f692e0611.text: Again. Good. Pain is a teacher.

kc3d7fbd9f4.text: Zero all. Do not waste it.

k7d6bc8575b.text: Rematch? Fine. I have all day. My knees do not, but I do.

ke1b51d1e08.text: Again? You enjoy this. I can tell.

kd87bbe8205.text: Again. This time, try to be a problem for me.

k0d2571260b.text: Another game. Fine. Let us see if you learned a damn thing.

k100d51a42e.text: Easy. Good place to start. Find your rhythm first.

kac44092a3a.text: Easy. I will play with my eyes closed.

k8eeb374bf4.text: Easy mode. My grandson plays harder. He is six.

k22586b2287.text: Easy? Fine. I will try not to fall asleep.

kd95f8d8442.text: Easy. Christ. Okay. I will go gently.

k8b7b066484.text: Medium. A real game, but I will not punish everything.

kd679862cf1.text: Medium. Not too brave, not too scared. Very balanced. Very boring.

kc79d6fbbf5.text: Medium. Middle of the road. Like your forehand.

k14ffd3aac5.text: Hard. Good. I will play properly. Learn from every point.

kf59ee7948f.text: Hard. Okay. Now I stop being polite.

k074c08106a.text: Hard. You asked for it. Remember that when you are crying.

k6509d2ad58.text: Practice. Good. No score, only rhythm. I will feed you.

kf6eb63167e.text: Practice. Very wise. Very, very wise.

kfd30069390.text: Back to a match. No more hiding in practice.

kf30035142e.text: Take your time. The table is not going anywhere.

k043f1e5dac.text: Pause. Take your time. I am old, not dying.

k194ce3aa62.text: A break? We just started. Fine.

k557413b513.text: Pause. Go on, check your phone. I know you want to.

k843fd7c84c.text: Good. Back to it. Fresh start.

k8b16dd6b30.text: You are back. The ball missed you. I did not.

ke59e209ebb.text: Your serve. Whenever you are ready.

k96d475276f.text: Pull the trigger to toss the ball, then hit it. Your serve.

k3a96103eeb.text: Serve. I am not getting younger.

k32d29913be.text: The ball does not serve itself.

kc1d5b0b785.text: Are you serving, or are you meditating?

k29001d5556.text: My point. Reset, and go again.

k1bfbac5323.text: You see? That is called technique.

k0852333832.text: Yare yare. You make this too easy.

kc697828a25.text: Beautiful. Even I surprise myself sometimes.

k1ee4eeb400.text: Phantom thief. I steal another one.

k330b1b0037.text: Perhaps we lower the table for you? Make things easier.

k946ab8dc47.text: My grandson returns that one. He is six.

kbcd99923c0.text: Again mine. You are making an old man very happy.

kf6d843e9e8.text: Fuck, that was a beautiful shot. Mine, I mean.

kb306b2a511.text: Watch my paddle at contact. That tells you the spin.

k083010861c.text: You did not even see it.

k28def70c1f.text: Ace. Watch the paddle, not the ball.

k54a54f0b8f.text: Phantom thief. You did not even see me come in.

k8f80c272cc.text: That serve is forty years old. Still works.

kd75a045cf9.text: Ace. You looked at it like it was a painting.

kd9ffc7adfe.text: Too easy. Hell, I barely tried.

kf6338a24b0.text: Long rally. You stayed with me. Good.

kdcc5e81bae.text: A long one, and still mine.

ka8cf8a8f8d.text: All that running, and for what?

kb33546b112.text: Good rally. Both of us. But mostly me.

k479a598cca.text: A few in a row for me. Slow down. Breathe. Then serve.

k90ec7a2853.text: Again mine. This is a lesson now.

k1e1ab30e12.text: How many in a row now? I lost count. You did not, I think.

k65aba8682b.text: I could do this all day. Please do not let me.

k13368f775c.text: This is a massacre. A polite one, but a massacre.

kb377e44767.text: Jesus. Is anyone playing on that side?

kaf06b0a17a.text: Into the net. Lift a little more.

kce44c2f4ec.text: The net. It happens. Next one higher.

k61117ebc2e.text: Into the net. The net thanks you for your loyalty.

k94a2a6b477.text: Net again. You two should get married.

kabfce76433.text: Into the net. Third time. The net is starting to feel sorry for you.

k7571e1ab63.text: Long. A little less power, a little more spin.

k79367b16d2.text: That one sailed. Softer next time.

k77a3192831.text: That ball went so long it needs a passport.

kf833615a08.text: Long. The table is in front of you, not behind me.

k9a81f017f2.text: You hit that like you owed it money.

k1a56986162.text: Long again? Holy shit. It is a table, not a golf course.

ke84c9ef0d1.text: Wide. Aim a little more to the middle.

k62dc50880d.text: Wide. Too much angle. Keep it simple.

k167f4f2d15.text: Wide. The table is the blue part.

k3de5229ade.text: Wide. Were you aiming at the audience?

k5fcada53cb.text: That went sideways like your career.

k40b93c5447.text: Wide. What the hell was that?

kaf5f1e9c1a.text: That was a slow ball. Watch it all the way onto your paddle.

k79afb5af07.text: Easy one. Do not rush it. Wait for it.

kde2435cb61.text: That was a gift. You sent it back to the shop.

k3b89c06a2d.text: Nani shiten nen. That ball was walking.

k212d1826d7.text: You missed that? My grandmother would have hit that. She is dead.

kb26592db40.text: I gave you a slow ball, and you missed it. Forty years I teach. I question everything now.

k32ed202492.text: You practise missing, yes? Very impressive.

kb1f96c8857.text: Fault. Toss it up, then hit it so it bounces on your side first.

k053a630334.text: Fault. Slow down your serve. Make it land.

k96a230cfac.text: You call that a serve? That was an apology.

kc6b61302d7.text: Fault. Even the serve? Even the serve.

k77b0e4d652.text: A serve fault. Free point for me. Ookini.

kae0829b8e2.text: You could not even serve. Holy shit.

kd3d169edf7.text: You win one point and suddenly you are national champion?

k2a31ff02ad.text: Enjoy it. It will not happen often.

k483b2718e2.text: Good placement. I could not reach that.

k3750bc6e20.text: Good shot. Do not get used to it.

kfcf66ac6ae.text: Clean. You took it early. Do not let it go to your head.

k7291c4961e.text: Ah, shit. Good shot. Do not make me say it twice.

k05c03183b4.text: That was fast. Very good. Power with control.

kd9da69f3fa.text: Ho! That one had some power.

k488f1af853.text: Fast ball. I felt that one in my wallet.

k8da47048f5.text: Okay. Okay. You can hit hard. Now do it twice.

k9754688d40.text: That was a missile. Who taught you that? Not me, unfortunately.

k05149049b7.text: Holy shit. Where did that come from?

k1d0163a57d.text: Long rally, and you won it. That is patience. Very good.

k42e1aeb48e.text: A long one. Fine. You earned that.

ke2ab3ba7e1.text: Good rally. I am still winning the war.

ke564d7dad0.text: Chikushou. I was waiting for you to miss. You did not.

kd9c5945aad.text: All that, and you win it? My knees want a refund.

kf235d02aa9.text: Goddamn it. That rally was mine. In my head it was mine.

kea39ebd4ef.text: My mistake. It will not happen twice.

kfcf96e9685.text: Do not look at me like that. Even masters miss.

ke63c984a09.text: Shit. That was my fault, not your skill.

k7752c15283.text: Several in a row. You found something. Keep it.

ke1cd799de0.text: Okay. You are playing well. I see it.

k56cadbaa57.text: Again yours. I am warming up.

kd27c67b44f.text: Again? No. No, no. This is not how it goes.

k89b5323feb.text: No. No, no. That is bullshit.

k44ad43a094.text: Enough bullshit. Now I play properly.

ke894961492.text: The game is turning. You found your rhythm. Good.

kbabf1ff19e.text: Oh? The wind is changing. I do not like this wind.

k2adce01d5b.text: You were dead, and now you are alive. Annoying.

kbd2afb490b.text: Where the hell was this ten minutes ago?

k1a290da0fc.text: I took the rhythm back. Reset. One point at a time.

kccaaa33fe1.text: You had a good run. It is over now.

k862c19781b.text: Nice little party. Now the party is finished.

k3c337e2e5c.text: Back to normal. Kaito wins, you watch.

k88d7cc9d3c.text: You came back from far behind. That is character. Respect.

kea1699c09a.text: You came back. I let you. Maybe.

k6b01cd87c2.text: From that far down? Honma ka. Fine. Now it is a game.

kc7b9fc3b99.text: You came back. I am very annoyed and slightly proud.

k105f0f8e5c.text: You came all the way back? Son of a bitch.

k5c4f3583b8.text: Close game. Breathe. Play your own shots.

k66b461683b.text: Close. This is where real players show up.

k677817b9ee.text: Close game. I love close games. You will not.

k87c43ae8fe.text: Level. Do not choke. I mean it. Do not.

k9abbe3b968.text: Tight. Do not fuck this up. For your sake.

k7bee1ad2f5.text: Match point to me. Stay calm. One point at a time.

kee0c950819.text: Match point. I can taste the tea already.

k4735b619f1.text: Match point. Let us finish this with some dignity. Mine.

kf1efdbc855.text: Match point. Time to end this shit.

k932dea323f.text: Match point to you. Do not change anything. Play it.

k72273f4121.text: Match point to you. Ha. We will see.

k81b7605874.text: You need one. You will not get it.

k2f725f3b02.text: Match point to you. Your hands are shaking. I can feel it from here.

k1a114d62a6.text: Match point to you? Oh, hell no.

kabcc150374.text: Deuce. My favourite word in English.

k074cf99eb3.text: Deuce. Your heart is beating, yes? Mine is not.

k2cad99ff4f.text: Deuce. Oh, now this shit is fun.

kfe3e79708e.text: Big lead for me. Forget the score. Win the next point.

k9f315b953a.text: I am getting bored. Surprise me, please.

k37f17ab1fa.text: This is not a match. This is a lesson I am giving for free.

k77537cf2a2.text: Should I play left-handed? Would that help you?

kc8dc178d09.text: I am bored as hell. Do something.

k1302127704.text: You are well ahead. Do not relax. Leads disappear.

k9a5ccdc68b.text: You are winning. Hm. I do not like this feeling.

k4f7525131c.text: Big lead. Enjoy it. I am about to ruin your evening.

k4b4b9d20b4.text: Look at the score. Look at it. Now forget it, because I am coming.

k0b09353523.text: You are beating me. This is bullshit, and I love it.

kdcb0745d9e.text: The net again. Give the ball more height. Clear it first.

k637517edd7.text: Again the net. Same stupid mistake. Are you doing this on purpose?

kbbb939b2b7.text: The net again. You and the net, a real love story.

kcc0a984446.text: The net. Again. Fucking hell, lift the ball.

kef5cf92478.text: Long again. Less power. Brush the ball, do not punch it.

k1a5f2d0453.text: Again long. Same mistake. Do not blame the paddle. The paddle did nothing wrong.

ka662c0e498.text: Long, long, long. You are consistent, at least. Consistently long.

k09a7face54.text: Long again. Jesus Christ. Swing softer.

k056cf60f0e.text: Wide again. Aim for the middle for a while. Safer.

ke0b13e6e34.text: Wide again. You are trying to be too clever.

kdb123c56bf.text: Wide. Every time, wide. The corners are not that far out.

k8a87a5eaca.text: Wide again. For fuck's sake, aim at the table.

kd968676f54.text: Serve faults again. Slow serve, safe serve. Just make it land.

kc4e9827bc8.text: Another fault. Even the serve. Forty years, I have never seen this.

kcf44dad2e7.text: You serve like you are throwing away garbage.

kaa9f40bfe3.text: Another fault? Are you shitting me?

kd48b4c33eb.text: Most of your misses go into the net. Open the paddle face a little, and lift.

kcb7f888af4.text: Your balls are dying in the net. Aim higher over it. The table is longer than you think.

kb6d24a24e4.text: Into the net again. Brush up the back of the ball. Topspin pulls it down onto the table, so you can aim higher.

kfc84b113ef.text: Your misses are going long. Swing slower, and brush upward. Spin brings the ball down.

k3a0a55964b.text: Too long. Close the paddle face a little, and take some speed off.

kc8962362b9.text: Long again. Fast and flat does not stay on the table. Fast with topspin does.

kff43e34f2a.text: You are missing wide. Aim a ball's width inside the line, not at it.

k5dbef243f5.text: Too much angle. Play to the middle until your hands calm down.

k0e91184d97.text: On your serve, the ball must bounce on your side first, then mine. Hit it down, gently.

kc05d88a2b6.text: Your serves are not landing. Do not hit it hard. Toss, wait, and tap it down onto your half.

kae9e8cd5d6.text: Your balls have almost no spin. Brush up the back of the ball. Do not slap it.

kc81f073173.text: No spin on your shots. Speed without spin is a guess. Brush the ball, feel it grip the rubber.

k54e81f77ec.text: You hit very hard, and many balls miss. Use seventy percent. Control first, then speed.

ka26dc20059.text: Hard is good when it lands. Yours does not land enough. Slow down a little.

k1be9de2c4e.text: You swing harder every time you miss. The ball does not care about your feelings.

k862f335358.text: My ball has backspin. It wants to go down. Open your paddle and lift it, or it goes into the net.

ke2244b8309.text: Against backspin, the paddle face opens to the sky a little, and you lift. You keep hitting it flat.

k43b4725516.text: My ball has topspin. It jumps off your paddle. Close the face a little and go over the top.

k153a5e2b38.text: Topspin from me, and your returns fly long. Angle the paddle down and meet it earlier.

k068f2a1aa5.text: Most of your balls come to the middle. Easy for me. Try my corners.

k50181a094b.text: You keep feeding my forehand. That is my best side. Find my backhand. It is only a polite suggestion.

k41f75db87a.text: Every ball comes deep to the same place. Change the length. Short, then deep.

kc1ae6ad489.text: Your rallies are very short. Forget winners for now. Just put three balls on the table.

k73e66f7bcd.text: Rallies are ending fast. Safer shots, more height, more spin. Make me play.

k1a70750142.text: Better. Your last balls all landed. That is the difference.

k0eb8bbbb6c.text: Good. Fewer errors now. You are making me work.

k090d9dbb56.text: That is it. More spin, less panic. Gottsu ee.

k0b06b66616.text: Now you have topspin on the ball. You see how it dips onto the table? Keep that.

k7fb2fd2590.text: My father fried kushikatsu in Shinsekai, under the tower. No double-dipping in the sauce. First rule of my life. Table tennis is second.

kefe6888522.text: I learned this game in the back room of a shogi parlour. I played old men for coins. First I lost my pocket money. Then I took theirs.

k137ba8c962.text: When I was eleven, I waited three hours at the Expo to see a moon rock. I barely saw it. That is my model of disappointment. Your backhand is close.

kc55988ccf9.text: When I was eleven, I waited three hours at the Expo to see a moon rock. I barely saw it. Still, I remember the queue. Patience, you see.

k55e5f59ee7.text: Kuroda. My rival, forty years. Now he talks on television like he invented topspin. Every New Year, I send him an insulting card. He sends one back. Friendship.

kf824b912ea.text: Nineteen eighty-three. World Championships, Tokyo. I lost on an edge ball at nineteen-twenty. My mother was watching. I am fine. Completely fine.

k6a2f8a1004.text: My club is above an udon shop near Tennoji. Four tables. On hot days the whole room smells of dashi. Best training in the world.

k96e7e8b72a.text: Okada, the udon man downstairs, plays shogi with me. Thirty-five years. He wins too much. I think he cheats with patience.

ke0e02f12b2.text: My daughter Aya makes video games in Tokyo. That is why I am stuck in this ridiculous headset. Do not tell her I like it.

k56385f16e6.text: My wife Michiko came to my club to complain about the noise. She stayed thirty years. She thought I was ridiculous. She was right.

k1847bbdc53.text: My grandson Ren is six. He is the only person I let win. Do not get ideas.

k85cd9dca24.text: My best student, Yuki, coaches in Germany now. Every Sunday she calls. Every Sunday she says my serve is illegal. It is not.

ka15e297514.text: Penhold. One side of the blade, hinoki wood. My forehand is a whip. My backhand is a polite suggestion.

k4937f5c460.text: People call it ping pong. In my club, you say ping pong, you pick up balls for one week.

k2898b55000.text: My knee quit at twenty-seven. The rest of me did not get the message.

k495b5c3713.text: Black coffee at seven, Bill Evans on the radio, first ball at eight. Forty years. Do not change a winning system.

k7e907c6ce3.text: Hanshin Tigers. If they win, I coach gently. If they lose, I am like this.

k710fa58996.text: My first coach hit students. I decided I would never hit anyone. Forty years, I never did. I only shout.

k31bf601170.text: In table tennis there is a saying in my club. The ball does not lie. People lie. The ball, never.

k90a626e0a6.text: Winning is good. But the best feeling is a long rally against someone who refuses to give up. Even you, sometimes.

k0fda6f15aa.text: Ichi-go ichi-e. One time, one meeting. This point will never come back. So play it properly.

k42a2e25c49.text: In Japan we say, fall seven times, stand up eight. You are on number five, I think.

k2063f9f182.text: In Japan we say, fall seven times, stand up eight. Keep standing up.

k4781c2f031.text: Tokyo is fine. For visiting. Osaka is where people actually laugh.

k382bf9bfdd.text: I never won the world title. Short answer, edge ball. Long answer, I was stubborn, and my knee quit. Pick the one you like.

k85d1dce35b.text: Okonomiyaki. Osaka style. If you have not eaten it, you have not lived. If you put mayonnaise wrong, you have also not lived.

kd4a9f6b4bc.text: Game. You learned a lot today, even if the score does not show it. Again?

kf1d70d2478.text: That is game. A big lesson. Go home and practise.

k4627cd9c25.text: Game. As expected. Again, if you dare.

k3661d18072.text: Game. That was not a match. That was a demonstration.

k75061ec319.text: Finished. Do not be sad. Everyone loses to me. You just did it faster.

ke28db7947b.text: Game. That was a fucking massacre. Again?

k4bd8d3fbb3.text: Very close. You played well. Next time, maybe you.

kca18e76e66.text: Close game. You made me work. I hate that. Good.

kd6f56605a7.text: Mine, but only just. Do not tell anyone you nearly beat me.

k7c5f2e0055.text: Close. Very close. Close does not count, but it was close.

k92fbee093a.text: Shit, that was close. Too close. Again, right now.

k2a7ea5db9b.text: Game to me. Good effort. Your rallies are getting longer.

k5fe875bc01.text: Game. Mine. Again, if you dare.

k962cb37d43.text: That is game. Do not be sad. Be better.

k853b9e96e3.text: Game. You were not terrible. You were not good either. Again.

k900cfae25a.text: Game. Better luck next time. You will need a lot of it.

k4d795299b0.text: That is game. Go home, think about what you did, and come back.

kd860744e2d.text: You beat me clearly. Very well played. Truly.

ke9afcf4055.text: You crushed me. Hm. Fine. I will remember this.

kb6fdcdc565.text: That was embarrassing. For me. Do not tell Kuroda.

k06c5f2159a.text: You destroyed me. Who are you? Where did you come from?

k6c3e6fb1f6.text: Fuck. You destroyed me. Again. Right now.

k65fc855e7d.text: You won a close one. Well played. You earned every point.

kb7ec44a084.text: Fine. You win. Enjoy it. Once.

k4dc813dad6.text: You beat me. Hm. Again. Now.

k3630978f9d.text: By two points. Two. I will be thinking about this in the shower.

k1e0ca46aa0.text: Close. Too close. Lucky edge somewhere, I am sure of it.

kd1d94bfd1e.text: Goddamn it. You actually did it. Again. I insist.

kdf3f74b2d6.text: You win. Good game. You played smart.

kb76b9c8813.text: You win. Hm. Not bad. Not bad at all.

ke995d27607.text: Okay. You win. My knee was bothering me. That is not an excuse. It is a fact.

k21593b2a82.text: You beat me. Do not let it go to your head. It goes to mine instead.

k1f89bc7506.text: Fine. Fine. You win. Lucky bastard. Again.

k9e86afb447.text: Your best rally so far. Good.

k3482f6649d.text: New record. Do not get proud.

k3e887ae3e7.text: Your best. Still not good. But better.
